Leah (CS): quick roundup from onboarding calls today — captured 5 short asks, flagging ones that affect renewals.
Omar (CS): paste please, i'll call out urgent ones.
Leah (CS): CSV snippet: 
```
acct,ask,type,impact,notes
seaport,per-env-config,feature,high,wants separate prod/staging keys and route defaults
cedar,auth-metadata,feature,medium,needs to persist user_id+role in logs for audit
harbor,usage-alerts,feature,high,alerts when spend > threshold to avoid surprise bills
```
Omar (CS): seaport renewal in 7 weeks — per-env config would remove major deployment blocker.
Priya (PM): per-env-config sounds like a combo of config + UI scoping. what's smallest ship?
Diego (Eng): we can add env-scoped route defaults + secrets mapping. ETA: spike 3d, ship MVP ~10d. auth-metadata is small — just include fields in usage events and exports (~2d).
Leah (CS): usage-alerts is important across multiple accounts — customers worried about unexpected spend. could be email + webhook.
Priya (PM): propose triage: 1) auth-metadata (quick win), 2) usage-alerts pilot for renewal-risk accounts, 3) per-env-config as a Q2 epic with CS pilot.
feedback-bot: created jira CS-4820 "auth metadata in usage exports" assigned to @diego.
Omar (CS): i'll attach two customer quotes to CS-4820 and CS-4821 (alerts) — ones that mention renewal risk.
Leah (CS): adding: "We can't prove who was using what environment, so auditors will fail us." — Seaport.
Priya (PM): good. Diego, can you add acceptance criteria for the export fields?
Diego (Eng): will add ACs: 1) include user_id and role in usage export, 2) respect PII redaction flags, 3) tests for backward compat.
Leah (CS): i'll notify Seaport and Harbor with proposed timelines and offer staging access. thanks team. :+1:
